verdict.rationale: Skyfire publishes API reference pages for charging and introspecting tokens, wallet balance, setting agent source IPs, and creating organization seller agents, all authenticated with a per-agent skyfire-api-key header. Tokens can also be created directly via the API. A live probe confirmed the token API is running and returns a structured key-gated error, and llms.txt is served. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec was found at any probed path, and API-key creation and seller service creation and approval are documented only as dashboard flows, not API calls.
